```python
newsletter = """
=============================================================
                   TECHFLOW MONTHLY UPDATE
                "Growing Together, Scaling Further"
=============================================================

🎉 EXCITING NEWS: WE'VE CLOSER SERIES B! 🎉

Dear TechFlow Team,

Last week, Sarah (CEO) shared the incredible news at our all-hands meeting - we've officially closed our Series B funding round! 

💰 $25M led by Accel
📰 Featured in TechCrunch (it's everywhere!)
🚀 47 reactions and counting in #general

This milestone wouldn't be possible without each of you. The energy and dedication across the company has been unprecedented. Let's keep this momentum going!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📈 WHAT'S HAPPENING THIS WEEK

• MARKETING: New onboarding flow is live!
  → 15% improvement in conversion rates
  → Already seeing great results across the board
  → Full credit to the Marketing team for crushing it!

• ENGINEERING: API Rewrite Project
  → 80% complete and going strong
  → The foundation for our next phase of growth
  → Exciting features coming soon!

• SALES: Enterprise Wins
  → 3 major enterprise deals signed this month
  → Including the big one with Salesforce!
  → Big thanks to Mike and the entire Sales team

• HIRING: We're Growing!
  → 12 new team members started this week
  → Including our new VP of Product
  → More exciting announcements coming soon!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🔥 WHY WE'RE EXCITED

The TechCrunch coverage has us buzzing, but the real story is what's happening here at TechFlow. We're building something special, and we're just getting started.

With $25M in the bank, a proven product-market fit, and a team that's hungry to grow - the future is bright.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🙏 THANK YOU

To every single one of you - from engineering to sales, marketing to support - thank you for your hard work, creativity, and dedication. This is YOUR success story too.

Let's keep pushing forward together!

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Questions? Drop a message or hit up your team lead.

Happy to chat? Join us in #general or schedule a 1:1.

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

TechFlow Inc. | 150 Employees and Growing | Series B Funded
=============================================================
"""

# Save to file
with open('/workspace/techflow_newsletter.md', 'w') as f:
    f.write(newsletter)

print("Newsletter created successfully!")
print("\n" + "="*60)
print("NEWSLETTER PREVIEW:")
print("="*60)
print(newsletter)
```
